Structural greys are spaced by perceptual lightness (CIE L*), not by WCAG ratio -- near black the ratio is compressed and cannot tell #141418 from #202024, while L* can. The steps below match the light set's own intervals: plate to well 9.2 against its 8.8, plate to plateEdge 4.1 against 3.8, plate to hairline 20.9 against 21.1, plate to outline 29.1 against 29.3.
